bug_semantics: The Express dashboard exposes GET /api/session-summary and GET /api/session-events without authentication. Each handler takes attacker-controlled req.query.sessionId, embeds it in `session-log-${sessionId}.jsonl`, joins that string to the hooks data directory, and reads the resulting path. A sessionId containing a slash followed by `..` components causes Node path normalization to escape the intended directory while retaining a caller-selected .jsonl suffix, so an unauthenticated network client can read any process-readable reachable JSONL file.
flaw_origin: Commit 051f27474d85d7f3299b56fc61bfcb0666a4e198 created src/server/web-server.ts and, in that same original implementation, first added both unauthenticated routes, their query-controlled sessionId values, the unvalidated path.join calls, and the fs.readFileSync sinks. Its parent has no web-server.ts at all; the later formatting commit 3638681fe49211777bbd362b4ec88a5e3aa24b24 only reformatted the already-vulnerable expressions and is not the BIC.
